requirements.statement: Every implementer task prompt, the phase-gate verify-app prompt, every sweep fix prompt, and the mechanical stages (verify-functional render and reconcile, create-trd grounding merge) end with the time-matters sentence, word for word. Must pass.
No audit verifier, judge, exercise, debug, triage or authoring prompt carries the sentence. Must pass.

Replay of the ten-task lightning-lane fixture, run ABAB (before, after, before, after). Sentence kept only if: median per-task implementer change falls by more than 20%; median per-phase gate change falls by more than 20%; no after-run has more failed tasks, retries or reconcile reopenings than its paired before-run; no after-run audit-build gap is absent from the baseline audit. Must pass.

ledger-timing.js prints per-agent_type median and max seconds and counts unfinished starts; with SMOKE_IMPL_ARGS unset the prompt is exactly /implement-trd docs/TRD/smoke-greet.md, and with --no-verify set it ends with --no-verify; a Jest test asserts this.
Five baseline run directories exist, each with a ledger holding at least one implementer and one verify-app start/stop pair; baseline/summary.txt and baseline/audit-gaps.txt exist.

Harness test shows the sentence at the end of task:*, gate:verify-app, fix:*, render, reconcile and ground:merge prompts, and not in audit-trd verify:*, judge, exercise, debug or triage prompts; each TIME_MATTERS constant equals the sentence exactly; each packages/core/workflows and .claude/workflows pair is byte-identical.

result.md states before and after implementer and verify-app median seconds, failed tasks, retry_count, reconcile reopenings per after-run, audit gaps absent from baseline, and one verdict line (keep, remove, or no measurable difference); on remove, FIX-003 edits are reverted in the same task.

Fixture trd.md parses via parseTrd to exactly AVAIL-B001..B009 and AVAIL-P001 in phases 1 (five tasks), 2 and 3 (four tasks), with no live flags, no deferred tasks, no warnings; phaseGroups returns [[1],[2],[3]]; each task has a grounding block; no Master Task List row contains the live marker; diff against source shows only the listed edits; other three documents' sha256 match sources.

With REPLAY_PREPARE_ONLY=1, one prepared clone per side: no git remote; ensemble.version 4.13.6; hooks equal template; only the sandbox block, unit-only line and battery line differ in CLAUDE.md, constitution.md, stack.md; process.md, verification.md, verification-notes.md byte-identical to base; four workflow files match that side's packages/core/workflows; docker shim refuses and exits non-zero; battery command exits 0; sides differ in exactly the nine named files; lightning-lane for-each-ref unchanged.

Jest with fixtures: pairAgents, perTask and compareRuns give the specified pair changes (-25%, 0%, implementer median -12.5%); streamed transcript rows sharing message.id count tool calls once and take max output_tokens (123); unfinished agents are in no pair; one-sided labels reported unmatched; repeated keys summed with dispatch count; summarize() output unchanged.

Four run directories (before-1, after-1, before-2, after-2) each holding dispatch.jsonl, implement.json, final text, project.txt, transcripts/ and source commit; runs.tsv in ABAB order with no overlap; three audit-build-report.md files with exit codes; reconcile-reopens.txt; lightning-lane refs unchanged.

replay/result.md states each judged median with both sides' seconds; failed tasks, retry_count sums and reconcile reopenings per after-run beside before-run figures; every after-audit finding marked also-in-baseline yes/no; verdict follows O3 exactly; on keep the FIX-003 harness test passes and workflow pairs are byte-identical; otherwise grep for Time matters prints nothing.
[test-gap] SMOKE_IMPL_ARGS prompt append (unset gives exact /implement-trd docs/TRD/smoke-greet.md; set to --no-verify ends with it) has a Jest or BATS test.

[defect] The non-keep acceptance check grep -rn "Time matters" packages/ .claude/ must print nothing, but it currently matches a verification note quoting the grep command (.claude/verification-notes.md:948); the sentence itself is absent from all workflow and prompt files. Fix so the check is meaningful.

open_questions: OQ-1 | Is a one-file trivial task large enough to show a speed difference? | Assumed: use it anyway; if medians are within 20%, report no measurable difference | owner-only | Resolved 2026-10-20 by the first measurement: no. Each agent ran 10-25s, mostly fixed overhead. The spread within one side (12.6-37.8s for the implementer after the change) was larger than the gap between the medians (.trd-state/speed-sentence/result.md). The replay uses a ten-task fixture instead.

OQ-2 | The zero-count rule judges each after-run on its own, not against the before-runs. The fixture's original run needed two repair passes, which its older runtime did not count as retries: three stale tests fixed after the phase-2 gate, and seven decisioning regressions fixed after phase 3 [ran]. Today's /implement-trd retries the whole phase on a red battery and counts it. If both sides retry, the rule returns remove for a reason that is not the sentence. Should a count that the before-runs also show still fail the after side? | Assumed: applied as written. The before-runs' counts are reported beside the after-runs', so a count the fixture causes is visible | owner-only | Resolved 2026-10-20, owner: judge against the before-runs. An after-run fails only if it has more failed tasks, retries or reconcile reopenings than its paired before-run, or an audit gap the baseline lacked. O3, the success paragraph and FIX-009 updated to match.

OQ-3 | AVAIL-B004 is replayed with two edits: its [LIVE] marker and its final Live sentence are removed. Is that acceptable, or should B004 and the two tasks that depend on it be dropped (leaving 7 tasks, below the 8-task floor)? | Assumed: edits applied, recorded in fixture provenance header and in Decision | owner-only | Resolved 2026-10-20, owner: accept the edit; replay 10 tasks with B004's [LIVE] marker and final Live sentence removed.
could_not_verify: No PRD, so validation against product intent is unchecked. This TRD has no source PRD, so the audit checked the delivered tree against the TRD only. Whether the work matches what the owner wanted, beyond what O1 to O3 record, was not checked.

How often the sentence drops required work. One after-run of two dropped two pieces of required work (a flag and a test); neither before-run did. Two runs per side show a signal, not a rate (replay/result.md, What this does and does not show).
Whether the gate's 33.7% fall is real. It rests on 6 phase pairs, and single gates varied by up to 69% between runs.
The sweep fix, grounding merge, render and reconcile prompts were never measured. The replay's --no-verify run does not reach them. Moot while the verdict is remove: the sentence is in none of them.
Whether the result holds for features of other sizes. The replay used one ten-task fixture.
Which copy of a named workflow wins when both the project's .claude/workflows/ and the plugin dir carry one. Not checked. The replay made it irrelevant by supplying both from the same side.

Whether the PATH shim reaches subagents' Bash calls. The pre-flight probed the lead session only (replay/docker-probe.txt: docker refused, exit 1). Subagents are inferred to inherit the same environment, not checked.
Why diningAlertSimulation.replay.test.ts fails offline at the base was not diagnosed. It is excluded from the battery either way.

Audit findings the audits did not raise were not searched for. Gap matching is a reading of model-written reports. Each finding absent from the baseline audit was then checked by grep in all four kept clones (replay/result.md), but nothing was checked that no audit flagged.

Latency drift between the four runs is limited by pairing adjacent runs, not removed. The control (the end-of-run review, which never gets the sentence) took 664s and 498s on the two after-runs, against 520s and 514s on the before-runs.

The fixture's own text is not fully verbatim. Its Q-2 objective and section 6.1 still say live-required while the clone runs unit-only, and section 5 still describes the dropped phase 4. All three audits read the same text, so any gap it causes appears in the baseline too.
